ec2-cpu-high.nrql: SELECT average(aws.ec2.CPUUtilization) FROM Metric WHERE aws.ec2.InstanceId = 'i-0abc123def4567890'

ec2-status-check-failed.nrql: SELECT max(aws.ec2.StatusCheckFailed) FROM Metric WHERE aws.ec2.InstanceId = 'i-0abc123def4567890'

rds-cpu-high.nrql: SELECT average(aws.rds.CPUUtilization) FROM Metric WHERE aws.rds.DBInstanceIdentifier = 'prod-db-1'

rds-free-storage-low.nrql: SELECT min(aws.rds.FreeStorageSpace) FROM Metric WHERE aws.rds.DBInstanceIdentifier = 'prod-db-1'

rds-connections-3-of-5.nrql: SELECT average(aws.rds.DatabaseConnections) FROM Metric WHERE aws.rds.DBInstanceIdentifier = 'prod-db-1'

lambda-errors.nrql: SELECT sum(aws.lambda.Errors) FROM Metric WHERE aws.lambda.FunctionName = 'checkout'

lambda-duration-high.nrql: SELECT average(aws.lambda.Duration) FROM Metric WHERE aws.lambda.FunctionName = 'checkout'

dynamodb-throttled.nrql: SELECT sum(aws.dynamodb.ThrottledRequests) FROM Metric WHERE aws.dynamodb.TableName = 'orders' AND aws.dynamodb.Operation = 'PutItem'

ecs-service-cpu.nrql: SELECT average(aws.ecs.CPUUtilization) FROM Metric WHERE aws.ecs.ClusterName = 'prod' AND aws.ecs.ServiceName = 'api'

lambda-error-rate.nrql: SELECT sum(aws.lambda.Errors) / sum(aws.lambda.Invocations) * 100 FROM Metric WHERE aws.lambda.FunctionName = 'checkout'

ec2-network-in.nrql: SELECT average(aws.ec2.NetworkIn) FROM Metric WHERE aws.ec2.InstanceId = 'i-0abc123def4567890'

s3-daily-size.nrql: not emitted: aggregation window 86400s is outside 30s-1h

actions-disabled-with-extras.nrql: SELECT sum(aws.sns.NumberOfNotificationsFailed) FROM Metric WHERE aws.sns.TopicName = 'orders'

Hostile \"name\" ${evil} %{if true} with.nrql: SELECT average(aws.ec2.CPUUtilization) FROM Metric WHERE aws.ec2.InstanceId = 'i-x\' OR 1=1 --'
